name: 生成图片
description: 仅在需要最终图片时调用。使用员工配置的 image_model_id 生成图片；角色、场景和风格母版通过 reference_urls 传入，返回可展示的永久图片 URL。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"完整、可直接生图的正向提示词"},"reference_urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":14,"description":"可选的角色、场景、风格母版 /uploads/ URL；按重要性排序"},"size":{"type":"string","enum":["1024x1024","1024x1536","1536x1024"],"default":"1024x1536"},"quality":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high","auto"],"default":"medium"}},"required":["prompt"]}
